title.zh: 论文称大模型可直接读写神经网络权重，Qwen 3.8 27B 本地可解读权重

summary.en: "Sparks of Weight-Space Programming" says LLMs can natively read and write network weights; Simon Willison reproduced weight interpretation with Qwen 3.8 27B on a laptop.

title.zh: 斯坦福研究：44% 的大模型研究结论已经过时
